 Home Local News LIHEAP Heating Assistance Now Available LIHEAP Heating Assistance Now Available
 Mon, November 9, 2026 by wcednews 
 SHARE NOW 
 UNDATED – If you’re struggling to pay your home heating bills, you can now apply for assistance through the LIHEAP program. 
 Eligible Households can now receive cash grants up to $1,000 dollars with additional help for heating emergencies.  
 Applications are accepted online at dhs.pa.gov slash COMPASS or by calling 1-866-857-7095. The program runs through April 23rd, 2027.
